raw_text: URGENT: Renewed clashes between Tatmadaw and Arakan Army near Bangladesh border. Fresh Rohingya refugee flows into Cox's Bazar reported. Bangladesh Border Guard (BGB) fired warning shots as crowds attempted crossing near Teknaf. Estimates of 500+ attempting to cross since dawn. Indian agencies monitoring for secondary migration via Tripura and Mizoram.
clean_text: Tatmadaw-Arakan Army clashes near Bangladesh border driving fresh Rohingya refugee flows to Cox's Bazar. BGB fired warning shots. India monitoring secondary migration routes.
